title: Digimon parameters
description: digimon.yaml: DIGIMON_DATA of the executable, one record per Digimon type (params.h: DigimonPara). packages/formats/src/exe/tables_yaml.cpp writes it.

index.description: The Digimon type: the index in DIGIMON_DATA.

moves.description: 16 move slots; slot i is the move of animation 0x2E + i. null = empty slot (0xFF).

condition_fx.description: Where the type's condition effects hang (CONDITION_FX_OFFSETS: translateConditionFXToEntity): a node of its model and an offset x, y, z in its space.

id.description: The string id other files use: the model file name in lowercase for an original, <pack id>:<name> for a Digimon a pack adds (docs/architecture/vfs.md).

text.description: A text of the executable. Printable ASCII is kept; a backslash is written \\ and any other byte \xNN.

reference.description: The id of the referenced record, null for none, or the raw number when it is outside its table.
